card.svarcade_tcg.special_lucario_mega.e: Once per turn, when Summoned or at the start of your turn: gain 1 Preparation counter (maximum 3). Once per turn per card name, as a Quick Effect: remove 1 Preparation counter; inspect the first Set enemy Trap, then protect this card from destruction until the end of this turn. Once per turn, when your opponent starts a Chain Link: automatically remove 3 Preparation counters if available; negate that activation and disable its source card’s effects until turn end.
Once per turn, when Summoned or at the start of your turn: gain 1 Willpower counter (maximum 3). Once per turn per card name, as a Quick Effect: remove 1 Willpower counter; protect the targeted ally from destruction and give it 200 Power until the end of this turn. Once per turn, when your opponent starts a Chain Link: automatically remove 3 Willpower counters if available; protect all allied Pokémon from destruction and give them 100 Power until turn end.
Once per turn, when Summoned or at the start of your turn: gain 1 Focus counter (maximum 3). Once per turn per card name, as a Quick Effect: remove 1 Focus counter; look at your top 3 Deck cards and order them by descending printed Power. Once per turn, when your opponent starts a Chain Link: automatically remove 3 Focus counters if available; remember its source and recover 350 LP at the next turn end.
Once per turn, when Summoned or at the start of your turn: gain 1 Solar counter (maximum 3). Once per turn per card name, as a Quick Effect: remove 1 Solar counter; return the first Level 4 or lower Pokémon in your Graveyard to your hand, then recover 300 LP. Once per turn, when your opponent starts a Chain Link: automatically remove 3 Solar counters if available; negate that activation and disable its source card’s effects until turn end.
Once per turn, when Summoned or at the start of your turn: gain 1 Growth counter (maximum 3). Once per turn per card name, as a Quick Effect: remove 1 Growth counter; regain 1 Growth counter and give allied Grass Pokémon 100 Power until the end of this turn. Once per turn, when your opponent starts a Chain Link: automatically remove 3 Growth counters if available; protect all allied Pokémon from destruction and give them 100 Power until turn end.
